---
title: "Before thesis submission"
status: "broad-beta resource"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

**Pause point:** Before uploading or formally submitting the thesis for examination.

**Prevents:** Submitting the wrong file, missing a formal requirement, obscuring contributions, or leaving unresolved permissions, confidentiality or integrity problems.

**Use:** Do-confirm.

## Critical checks

- [ ] Current official submission, notice-of-intention, format and examination requirements have been checked.
- [ ] The thesis states its overall problem, contribution and the relationship between its studies or chapters.
- [ ] Claims, terminology, methods, results, tables, figures and conclusions are internally consistent.
- [ ] Publications, co-authored work and individual contributions are declared as required.
- [ ] Ethics, governance, data, conflict, funding and research-integrity statements are accurate and complete.
- [ ] Copyright, permissions, third-party material and licence conditions have been checked.
- [ ] The final rendered file has been checked page by page for missing content, broken cross-references, unreadable figures, comments and tracked changes.
- [ ] Accessibility, file format, size and upload requirements have been tested using the exact intended file.
- [ ] Confidentiality, embargo and sensitive-material arrangements are confirmed in writing where required.
- [ ] Source files, the final submitted copy and supporting records are stored in an approved, recoverable location.
- [ ] I understand the examination, correction, appeal, publication and repository steps that follow submission.

## Stop condition

Do not submit an unchecked file or while authorship, permissions, confidentiality, required declarations or formal eligibility remain unresolved.

## Evidence to retain

Keep the exact submitted thesis, upload receipt, final source archive, permissions, declarations, approval evidence and submission checklist.

## Completed scenario

The final PDF renders and the filename says `final`, but page inspection finds a missing appendix, one unresolved cross-reference and comments embedded in the PDF. The checklist fails. Regenerate from the authoritative source, inspect every page, test the upload copy, record its stable identity and submit only that verified file. A successful render alone was not the submission gate.

## Sceptical-reader test

Ask another person to locate the overall contribution, candidate contribution declaration, primary method justification, strongest limitation and one reported result using only the final file. Repair navigation or explanation that prevents recovery.

::: {.callout-warning title="Check locally"}
Only the institution can confirm candidature eligibility, submission requirements, examination procedures and repository obligations.
:::
